messages:
sophie: heads-up — after the eu-west spike yesterday i want to re-open the idle GPU drain policy convo. we had two short-lived jobs get their pods evicted while warm pool cooldown was 10m.
priya: ugh. yeah that led to cold-starts and qps blips for the realtime reranker :grimacing:
leo: can you paste the timeline? was it the autoscaler draining nodes or k8s evicting due to resource pressure?
sophie: autoscaler draining. metrics show node idle for ~12m then drained. Pod disruption budget kicks in but our qos was bespoken and we didn't have a warm fallback.
sanjay: looks like our cluster-autoscaler flags: --scale-down-delay-after-add=10m --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m — that's pretty aggressive for gpus.
priya: right. proposal: bump scale-down-unneeded-time to 30m and add a warm-pool size of 1 per zone for gpu nodepools. also add annotation to jobs to opt-out of warm-pool eviction: gpu.redwood/keep-warm=true
leo: agree on warm pool. also we should gate scale-to-zero on gpu idle metric: GPUUtil < 5% for 30m AND pendingJobs==0. otherwise keep node around.
sophie: here's a quick sketch of the kube obj we used for warm pool (from test):
```
apiVersion: cluster.k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: WarmPool
metadata:
  name: gpu-pool-eu-west
spec:
  minSize: 1
  maxSize: 2
  selectors:
    nodepool: gpu-rt
```
priya: that looks fine. question: warm pool costs — adding 1 per zone scales cost ~+3 GPUs / month. but prevents early evictions and cold-starts; cost vs sla impact trade-off.
sanjay: we can mitigate cost by setting autoscaling policy to allow preemption of warm nodes for batch, and set warm nodes to cheaper instance types if compatible.
leo: also consider increasing cooldown window in the nodepool controller. current cooldown is 600s; make it 1800s.
oncall-bot: incident 2025-11-14-24 linked — evictions due to aggressive scale-down. doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2025-11-14-24
sophie: TL;DR action items: 1) stage change in canary cluster: scale-down-unneeded-time=1800, scale-down-delay-after-add=15m; 2) create warm-pool manifest per gpu nodepool with minSize=1; 3) add opt-out annotation to critical jobs; 4) run cost sims next week.
priya: i'll open the PR with canary flag and add rollout plan (canary eu-west, monitor 72h). assign to @leo for warm-pool manifests + @sanjay for cost sim.
leo: on it. i'll also add a metric rule that blocks scale-to-zero if pendingJobs>0 for nodepool 'gpu-rt'.
sanjay: i'll run the cost sims with 3 configs (no warm pool / 1-per-zone / 2-per-zone) and include p95 cold-start latency impact.
sophie: thanks. let's aim to ship canary by end of week. ping me if you need infra creds. :thumbsup:
priya: noted. adding to agenda for infra sync on thursday.
sophie: thanks all — closing thread, will post results.
